references.text: Jethro gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses as a wife, establishing the family relationship mentioned in Exod 18:2.
Zipporah is mentioned here in connection with the circumcision of her son, showing her role in Moses' family.
Miriam and Aaron criticize Moses for his Cushite wife, which may refer to Zipporah or another wife.
Jethro is identified as a priest in Midian and Moses' father-in-law, the same family relationship described in Exod 18:2.
Moses asks Jethro for permission to return to Egypt, which may explain why Zipporah was sent back.
